sha_discrepancy_note: The assignment SHA differs from both the current file SHA and audit/asset_sha256.json by one hex character. The observed file hash agrees with the existing project hash record.

criteria.name: Identity and source match
criteria.basis: Official Purdue ArcGIS feature FID 260 is explicitly PGU, with matching name/address and preserved raw GeoJSON. CE Solutions image corroborates facade identity.

criteria.name: Footprint, dimensions and orientation
criteria.basis: Raw GIS converted bounds are 82.36 x 95.93 m; evaluated asset bounds are 83.00 x 96.45 m. The small increase is compatible with modeled piers/facade projections. Deck plates are generated directly from the source polygon; no independent surveyed orientation check is available.

criteria.name: Placement anchor and modular coordinates
criteria.basis: The saved collection stores midpoint-derived anchor [-303.865845, -72.763426] m; geometry is in the local frame. Full campus integration placement was outside this asset-only review.

criteria.name: Floor count and vertical dimensions
criteria.basis: Six deck plates match the GIS six-level attribute. Approximately 15.06 m height and 2.85 m floor spacing are estimates: GIS vertical fields have ambiguous units/meaning and no measured elevation source was found.

criteria.name: Exterior facade fidelity
criteria.basis: Open dark bays, concrete spandrels, red-brown piers, glazed core slots and entry/exit signs resemble the single CE Solutions photo. In comparison the model bands appear too thin/uniform and its four prominent corner cores are unsupported by that reference, which shows a dominant brick tower and a smaller distant core. Exact current entrances/elevations are unverified.

criteria.name: Parking interior and circulation
criteria.basis: The asset has support columns, representative stall stripes, four cores and ramp flights. No verified floorplan was found. Ramp slabs do not establish verified continuous circulation, landings or turning paths; parking layout remains generalized.

criteria.name: Materials, dependencies and asset portability
criteria.basis: A fresh Blender process opened the expected scene/collection. Named procedural concrete, coating, brick, glazing and marking materials are assigned. No unpacked external images; library collection name is stable.

criteria.name: Evidence quality and uncertainty reporting
criteria.basis: Evidence includes source URLs, providers, feature ID, retrieval date, CRS, conversion/measurement method, raw GIS, comparison photo and explicit vertical/interior/access uncertainties.

unresolved_findings: Exact total height and floor-to-floor spacing are estimates, not verified measurements.
No verified garage floorplan; ramp continuity and exact stall/support arrangement remain unverified.
Facade assessment relies on one oblique project photo; modeled band/core proportions differ from the reference.
Placement/collision within the full campus master was outside this library-only review.
summary: Passes at 8.15/10. The library is portable, correctly identified and anchored in its documented local frame, and closely matches official footprint bounds and the six-level count. Height, internal circulation, current access layout and some facade proportions remain uncertain.
